<documents>
<document id="savings-rate-change-2026">
Savingsˆrateˆchange,ˆJuneˆ2026ˆOnˆJuneˆ1,ˆ2026,ˆweˆchangedˆtheˆratesˆonˆSavingsˆPockets.ˆHereˆareˆtheˆoldˆandˆnewˆrates.ˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆBeforeˆ|ˆFromˆtheˆchangeˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ0.75%ˆ|ˆ0.50%ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ2.50%ˆ|ˆ2.00%ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ4.10%ˆ|ˆ3.75%ˆ|ˆ##ˆWhyˆOurˆsavingsˆratesˆfollowˆwiderˆinterestˆrates,ˆwhichˆcameˆdownˆoverˆtheˆpastˆyear.ˆWeˆkeptˆtheˆgapˆbetweenˆplansˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆneedˆtoˆdoˆNothing.ˆYourˆpocketsˆstartedˆearningˆtheˆnewˆrateˆautomatically.ˆInterestˆearnedˆbeforeˆtheˆchangeˆwasˆcalculatedˆatˆtheˆoldˆrate.ˆ##ˆNoticeˆWeˆemailedˆeveryˆmemberˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆtheˆchange.ˆ##ˆBalanceˆcapˆTheˆcapˆdidn'tˆchange.ˆPlanˆratesˆapplyˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆ##ˆThinkingˆaboutˆswitchingˆplans?ˆTheˆrateˆyouˆearnˆdependsˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆUpgradingˆtakesˆeffectˆimmediately,ˆsoˆyourˆpocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆhigherˆrateˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆCompareˆplansˆinˆtheˆappˆbeforeˆyouˆdecide.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="docs-verification-letter">
AccountˆverificationˆletterˆAnˆaccountˆverificationˆletterˆconfirmsˆthatˆyouˆhaveˆanˆopenˆaccountˆwithˆus.ˆLandlords,ˆemployersˆandˆgovernmentˆofficesˆsometimesˆaskˆforˆone.ˆ##ˆGetˆaˆletterˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆAccountˆverificationˆletter.ˆTheˆPDFˆisˆreadyˆrightˆawayˆandˆshowsˆyourˆname,ˆaccountˆnumber,ˆaccountˆtypeˆandˆtheˆdateˆtheˆaccountˆwasˆopened.ˆ##ˆShowingˆyourˆbalanceˆYouˆcanˆchooseˆwhetherˆtheˆletterˆincludesˆyourˆcurrentˆbalance.ˆ##ˆCustomˆlettersˆWeˆcan'tˆwriteˆcustomˆletters,ˆsignˆforms,ˆorˆfillˆinˆthird-partyˆverificationˆforms.ˆTheˆstandardˆletterˆisˆacceptedˆbyˆmostˆorganizations.ˆ##ˆClosedˆaccountsˆLettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆForˆaˆclosedˆaccount,ˆuseˆyourˆfinalˆstatement.ˆ##ˆSomeoneˆelseˆaskingˆWeˆdon'tˆconfirmˆaccountˆdetailsˆtoˆlandlords,ˆemployersˆorˆanyoneˆelseˆwhoˆcontactsˆusˆdirectly.ˆGiveˆthemˆtheˆletterˆyourself.ˆ##ˆIsˆitˆofficial?ˆYes.ˆTheˆletterˆcarriesˆaˆverificationˆcodeˆthatˆtheˆrecipientˆcanˆcheckˆonˆourˆhelpˆcenter.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-metal">
TheˆPremiumˆmetalˆcardˆPremiumˆmembersˆgetˆaˆmetalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆworksˆexactlyˆlikeˆtheˆplasticˆcard,ˆwithˆtheˆsameˆnumber,ˆlimitsˆandˆcontrols.ˆ##ˆGettingˆyourˆmetalˆcardˆWhenˆyouˆupgradeˆtoˆPremium,ˆtheˆappˆasksˆwhetherˆyouˆwantˆaˆmetalˆcardˆnowˆorˆatˆyourˆnextˆrenewal.ˆIfˆyouˆorderˆitˆnow,ˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆmetalˆone.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆitˆReplacementsˆforˆaˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamagedˆmetalˆcardˆareˆmetalˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆisˆfreeˆonˆPremiumˆtoo,ˆandˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆleaveˆPremiumˆYourˆmetalˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆitˆexpires.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆorˆifˆyouˆneedˆaˆreplacement,ˆyou'llˆgetˆaˆplasticˆcard.ˆ##ˆDisposalˆMetalˆcardsˆcan'tˆbeˆcutˆwithˆscissors.ˆWhenˆyouˆreplaceˆone,ˆyouˆcanˆmailˆitˆbackˆtoˆusˆinˆtheˆprepaidˆenvelopeˆthatˆcomesˆwithˆtheˆnewˆcard,ˆandˆwe'llˆrecycleˆit.ˆContactlessˆworksˆonˆmetalˆcardsˆtheˆsameˆwayˆitˆdoesˆonˆplastic.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
